title: Manifest-first dependency identity
summary: Accepted package identity comes from integration.json when present. Directory names are a legacy layout fallback only. A present malformed manifest is corruption and must fail closed.
invariants: Semantic identity is package.name + package.version from integration.json.
A directory name may disagree with semantic identity; the manifest wins.
Directory parsing is permitted only when integration.json is absent.
Decode failure of a present integration.json must not silently downgrade to directory-name inference.
The catalogue records whether identity came from MANIFEST or DIRECTORY_FALLBACK.

provenance.claim: Core rules make integration.json semantic identity and directory naming legacy fallback.
Manifest-first repository catalogue and explicit corruption behavior.
Producer contract repeats manifest-first accepted identity.
